  elif t==2:

item.text:
Created a forest-green fern “F” paired with a literary serif wordmark.

- [Full logo — logo.svg](./logo.svg)
- [Icon — mark.svg](./mark.svg)

Both are self-contained vectors with outlined lettering. The icon was visually checked at 16px.
